parent_objective: audit materialized scenario-quality redesign protocol artifacts before reset/static preflight or measured execution
blocked_by: M2455 materialized protocol artifacts and must be audited before reset/preflight or execution
scenario redesign execution, repair, training, and ranking remain blocked until materialization is accepted
supersedes: direct reset/preflight from M2455 without result audit
direct measured rollout from materialized protocol artifacts
direct scenario redesign execution, repair, or training

public_gates: M2456 must audit M2455 summary, candidate rows, role protocol rows, guardrails, claim boundary, and decision rows
M2456 must decide whether materialization supports reset/static preflight, branch synthesis, or stop
M2456 must preserve non-ranking and no-winner claim boundaries
M2456 must not rerun rollout, execute scenario redesign, repair, train, rank, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not rank scenario candidates as winners
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M2455 materialized protocol artifacts before any reset/static preflight or execution route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rollout, policy action, scenario-redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if materialized groups are incomplete
stop if claim boundaries are violated
stop if no bounded reset/static preflight or synthesis route is supported
stop if the next route would run measured rollout without preflight
fallback_plan: route to reset/static preflight if materialization is accepted
route to branch synthesis if materialization is too broad
stop for user review if claim boundaries are violated

training_stage.stage_objective: scenario-quality redesign protocol materialization result audit
allowed_updates: M2456 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2455 materialization is accepted or rejected
a bounded reset/static preflight, synthesis, or stop route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2456 audits scenario-quality protocol materialization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2456; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization is incomplete or violates claim boundaries, stop or synthesize before preflight or execution.

local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit or block reset/static preflight before any measured rollout

the next route would execute measured rollout without reset/static preflight

hypothesis: Auditing M2455 can decide whether materialized scenario-quality protocol artifacts support reset/static preflight, synthesis, or stop without rollout, redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2455 summary, candidate rows, guardrail rows, claim boundary, and decision rows are audited
a bounded reset/static preflight, synthesis, or stop route is selected
no rollout scenario-redesign execution repair training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2456 reruns measured validation or policy action
M2456 executes scenario redesign, repair, or training
M2456 ranks scenario candidates, candidate families, controllers, selected checkpoints, or panel rows as winners
M2456 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2456 passes if it audits M2455 and selects a bounded reset/static preflight, synthesis, or stop route without rollout, scenario redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
